date_text: Thu, Nov 19th • 12:00 PM AEDT - Sun, Nov 22nd • 10:00 PM AEDT
description: This week we're heading to the Central New South Wales with Badlands Brewing, straight from Orange. Founded in 2010 by home-brewer turned owner/brewer Jon Shiner, Badlands has built its name on beers that are, in his words, "dangerously drinkable": hand-crafted in small batches, unfiltered and free of preservatives and additives. Fresh off a haul of nine medals at the Sydney Royal Beer & Cider Show, including gold for their New World Pilsener, Badlands is one of regional NSW's most exciting independent breweries. Tap list: - Cerveza - Darkness nitro - Harald's Hef - Heaps Hoppy - Cider - Jaxon red ipa - ΝΕΧT NΕΙΡΑ - PayDirt fresh hop corn lager - New world pils - U-Boat - Draughty kilt - XPA
